description: This file defines an abstract class 'GenericMap' implementing the Map interface with thread-safe features, custom iterators, and internal state management. It provides core map functionalities and mechanisms for extension.

classes.name: GenericMap
classes.description: An abstract thread-safe implementation of the Map interface with custom iterator support and internal state management.

methods.name: getModCount
methods.description: Returns the current modification count of the map.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the map if it is not empty, updating the modification count.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in the map.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on entrySet, keySet, and values.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, supporting comparison with other maps and GenericMap instances.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves value for a key, with optional access note.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns the set of map entries, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Abstract method to create an iterator over map entries.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns the set of keys, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns the collection of values, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the map, updating modification count.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Adds all entries from another map into this map.

methods.name: putAllInternal
methods.description: Internal method to add entries from another map, handling different map types.

methods.name: putAllIterator
methods.description: Abstract method to insert entries from an iterator.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the map.

methods.name: appendTo
methods.description: Appends string representation of the map to a StringBuilder.
